subject.title: fix(review): bind mutations to reviewed activity

question: Should the review-activity guard land now as the foundational fail-closed safety layer before the stacked repair and proof mutation changes?
rationale: The patch deliberately trades some automation availability for stronger human-review authority, and the two dependent PRs make rollout order a maintainer-owned operational choice.

options.title: Land the foundation first
options.body: Merge this PR after the current-head checks and review are complete, then rebase and review the dependent repair and proof PRs separately.

options.title: Review the full stack first
options.body: Keep this PR open until maintainers have assessed the combined availability and mutation-boundary effects of all three stacked changes.

recommendation.title: Land the foundation first
recommendation.body: Merge this PR after the current-head checks and review are complete, then rebase and review the dependent repair and proof PRs separately.
